briefdescription.para: KernelRegistry extended methods — validation, fallback resolution, enumeration, and summary formatting.

detaileddescription.para: Issue: #5382 — GPU/VRAM Layer: Refactor, vereinheitlichen und Shader-Vollständigkeit sichern

Implements the extended API added to KernelRegistry (compute_backend.h) and the convenience delegates on BackendRegistry:
KernelRegistry::lookupANNWithFallback()
KernelRegistry::lookupGeoWithFallback()

BackendRegistry::getKernelRegistry()
